runtime_context.buy_path: native BNB value sent to MemeRouter.buyMemeToken

root_cause: The native-BNB buy path can receive a fresh lifecycle signal for ERC20-quoted tokens because lifecycle status does not include quote asset and helper validation was skipped. ERC20-quoted buys revert with ERC20 insufficient allowance because this runtime does not approve or spend the quote token.

src/core/trader.py: Add NATIVE_QUOTE_ADDRESS and quote normalization helpers.
Reject unsupported non-native quote assets in check_token_status.
Add check_token_quote_supported for fast-path quote validation.
src/trader/bot.py: When lifecycle fast status is used, call check_token_quote_supported before buy submission.
If quote unsupported or helper quote lookup fails, emit BUY_NOT_READY and do not call buy_token.
Include token_quote in BUY_NOT_READY audit rows.
tests/core/test_hybrid_requirements_cont: Regression test for non-native quote rejection in check_token_status.
Regression test that fast lifecycle non-native quote does not call buy_token.
Happy-path coverage that fast lifecycle native quote still validates quote support and proceeds.
Structured failure coverage that check_token_quote_supported returns ready=false when helper quote lookup raises.

verification.red_tests: Both added tests failed before implementation: check_token_status returned ready=true and fast lifecycle did not await quote guard.

external_review.conclusion: Unsupported non-native quote explanation is strong; recommended two-layer gate: check_token_status plus fast-path quote validation.

smartsearch.reason: This round fixed a live execution root cause using local logs, on-chain receipts, and helper state; it did not introduce a new model method, label, feature, or external research claim.
